text:
Maya: Quick check-in on DeltaWave account — noticed an uptick in 5xx/timeouts this week during peak ingest. Sharing the quick breakdown I pulled from pulse.

Tristan: Thanks Maya — can you paste the top endpoints and counts?

Maya: Sure, raw from the query (last 7d):
```
/v1/generate    5xx: 42  (12% of account failures)
/v1/chat        504: 35  (10%)
/v1/embed       429: 22  (6%)
/v1/stream      524: 18  (5%)
/health/ping    500: 9   (2%)
Total 5xx/timeouts: 126
```
Also seeing a ~3x jump in `429` rate during a deploy window on Tue 03:00 UTC.

OpsBot: [alert] DeltaWave: sustained error rate >2% for 45m on route `/v1/generate` at 2026-03-17T03:12Z :fire:

Lia: Does their route config use aggressive retries from the client? 429s can cascade into 5xx if they retry without backoff.

Maya: Their SDK usage shows a spike in concurrent sessions from onboarding tests — likely bursty calls hitting shared token limits.

Samir: Can we confirm model-side resource limits? Might be queuing timeouts from the inference pool. Tristan, can runtime check the qps->latency correlation for that timeframe?

Tristan: On it. Initial look — queuing latency on our GPU pool for the instance serving `/v1/generate` spiked ~220ms -> 850ms at the same window. Opening an infra ticket.

Maya: Created CS ticket CS-4829 to track customer comms and mitigation. Noted their renewal is next quarter; flagging as medium risk if not resolved.

Lia: Short-term mitigation suggestions: 1) enable client-side exponential backoff (we have snippet), 2) route heavy batch workloads to our dedicated variant or lower-req model, 3) bump rate limit temporarily for the account while we stabilize.

Maya: Pasting backoff snippet for their engineers:
```
async function sendWithBackoff(req) {
  for (let i=0;i<5;i++) {
    try { return await fetch(req); }
    catch (e) { await sleep(2**i * 100); }
  }
  throw new Error('max retries');
}
```

Samir: Recommend we also enable prefix KV caching for their chat flow — should cut token work by ~20% and reduce load on `/v1/generate`.

Tristan: Infra ticket INF-911 created: investigating GPU queue contention and autoscaler behavior during Tue 03:00 UTC. Attaching logs and tail of the service: `grep "queue_wait_ms" runtime.log | tail -n 50` shows repeated ~600-900ms spikes.

Maya: I'll propose the temporary rate bump to 2x for their service plan and send a short note to the customer with recommended client changes + ETA for infra follow-up.

OpsBot: [note] Next probe scheduled in 30m. Will post updates here.

Lia: Who's owning the follow-up with engineering for a permanent fix? If infra finds autoscaler mis-tune we should schedule a rollback window.

Tristan: I'll own follow-up and loop infra. Expecting an update within 6 hours.

Maya: Thanks all — action items: Maya -> customer note + CS-4829 updates; Tristan -> INF-911 investigation; Lia -> share backoff + caching guide; Samir -> prepare routing recommendation for Dedicated variant. Check back here after infra update. :thumbsup:
